vignette: A 25-year-old woman has had blurred vision in the left eye for three days with pain on moving the eye. Acuity is 6/36 on the left, colors look washed out, and the left pupil dilates when the light is swung onto it from the right eye. The fundus is normal.
explanation: Monocular visual loss with color desaturation, pain on eye movement, a relative afferent pupillary defect and a normal disc is retrobulbar optic neuritis of that nerve. Chiasmal and retrochiasmal lesions produce bilateral or homonymous field defects.
